Sales Analytics: Sales trends over time by customer, item, territory or group, in value or quantity
Sales Register: Every sales invoice with taxes and totals for a period
Gross Profit: Profit per invoice, item or customer: selling rate against valuation cost
Item-wise Sales History: Which items were sold to which customers, with quantity and rate
Sales Order Analysis: Sales orders against delivery and billing: what is pending or overdue
Customer Ledger Summary: Per customer opening balance, invoiced, paid and closing balance
Accounts Receivable: Unpaid customer invoices by age: who owes us money and how overdue
Accounts Receivable Summary: Outstanding receivable per customer in age buckets
Accounts Payable: Unpaid supplier bills by age: what we owe and what is overdue
Accounts Payable Summary: Outstanding payable per supplier in age buckets
Supplier Ledger Summary: Per supplier opening balance, purchases, payments and closing balance
Purchase Register: Every purchase invoice with taxes and totals for a period
Purchase Analytics: Purchase trends over time by supplier, item or group, in value or quantity
General Ledger: Every accounting entry for an account, party or voucher in a period
Trial Balance: Opening, debit, credit and closing balance of every account
Profit and Loss Statement: Income against expenses and net profit or loss over periods
Balance Sheet: Assets, liabilities and equity at a date
Cash Flow: Cash movement from operating, investing and financing activity
Stock Balance: Quantity and value of stock per item and warehouse at a date
Stock Projected Qty: Stock on hand, ordered, reserved and projected per item and warehouse
Stock Ledger: Every stock movement in and out per item and warehouse
Stock Ageing: How long stock has been sitting, by item and age range
